## Context / Problem
`AGENTS.md` says launch-loaded guidance must stay lean and point to maintained documentation (`AGENTS.md:10-15`), but its background-process section embeds a dated incident narrative, operator recovery procedure, and detector explanation across lines 252-330. Every agent pays that context cost even when it only needs the prevention contract.

## Approach
- Replace the long `AGENTS.md` section with a compact, imperative prevention contract that retains the safety invariants, spawn-time bound and process-group cleanup example, explicit exemption for bounded LLM gate operations, and a pointer to detailed documentation.
- Move the incident evidence, detector usage, false-positive interpretation, and operator recovery procedure into a new maintained operations page at `docs/orphaned-processes.md`.
- Add the new page to the Operations section of `docs/README.md`.
- Preserve commands and facts needed to prevent, detect, and reclaim orphaned processes. Do not copy unrelated tracker or implementation history.

## Scope
- `AGENTS.md`: compress the launch-loaded background-process rule.
- `docs/orphaned-processes.md`: own the detailed incident evidence, prevention rationale, detector interpretation, and operator recovery steps.
- `docs/README.md`: index the new operations page.

## Testing
- Run `python scripts/check_docs_index.py`.
- Run the repository documentation checks and `make lint` with the worktree virtualenv first on PATH.
- Inspect the rendered Markdown structure and verify every moved command and safety invariant remains reachable.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The `AGENTS.md` background-process section contains no more than 35 logical lines.
- [ ] The compact section includes a wall-clock-bounded spawn plus process-group cleanup example.
- [ ] The compact section states that no spawned process may reach PPID 1 and that each subagent must reap its own helpers.
- [ ] The compact section prohibits unbounded busy loops without a wall-clock bound.
- [ ] The compact section explicitly forbids applying timeouts to bounded LLM gate operations.
- [ ] Dated incident evidence is absent from `AGENTS.md` and present in `docs/orphaned-processes.md`.
- [ ] Orphan-detector interpretation and operator reclamation steps are absent from `AGENTS.md` and present in `docs/orphaned-processes.md`.
- [ ] The Operations section of `docs/README.md` links `orphaned-processes.md` and describes it as the prevention, detection, and recovery procedure for orphaned processes.
- [ ] The detailed page documents the bounded-spawn, process-group-cleanup, read-only-detection, and confirmed-reclamation commands.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_docs_index.py` passes.
- [ ] `make lint` passes with the worktree virtualenv first on PATH.
- [ ] Gerrit reports `LLM-Review +1`.
- [ ] Gerrit reports `Verified +1`.
- [ ] Gerrit reports no unresolved comments.
- [ ] The change is submitted to `main`.

## Verification
Compare the pre-change and post-change section line counts, search both files for each preserved invariant and command, run the documentation index/link checker, run `make lint`, then confirm Gerrit labels and merged status before closing the ticket.
